issuer: the Service de la Circulation (the Direction de la Circulation et de la Police Routière, DCPR), with the licence tax paid to the Direction Générale des Impôts (DGI)

licence.name: permis de conduire, type A (véhicule automobile jusqu’à 3 500 kg)

note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Direction Générale des Impôts' own service page, Taxe Permis de Conduire (undated). The licence tax is paid when the licence is delivered; a provisional licence (three months) is given on the Service de la Circulation's authorisation to a learner who has passed the theory examination, and the permis définitif after the theory and practical tests under the Service de la Circulation's supervision. Type A is the licence for a motor vehicle up to 3,500 kg (the car licence; Haiti's type B is for heavy vehicles). Age: the page says a type A licence is delivered to minors of at least 16 only with the Service de la Circulation's express authorisation (and a parent's written authorisation is among the papers for a minor); 16 is held as the youngest it is issued to, as the form's 'from' asks, with that authorisation (the page gives no other age for type A). Fee: 2,500.00 gourdes for types A, B and E, of which 500 gourdes go to the Fonds d'Entretien Routier (FER); the tax is charged every five years, and the licence is valid for five years. The issuer is read from the page's own words (delivered under the Service de la Circulation's authorisation and supervision, records held by the DCPR, the tax paid to the DGI); the page doesn't name the office that hands over the card. The international permit (1,000 gourdes, one year, from 18) is not held. No identity card is issued by this office, and no exchange list was read.

sources.title: Direction Générale des Impôts (Haïti), Taxe Permis de Conduire
sources.said: La taxe dite de Permis de Conduire est acquittée lors de la délivrance au conducteur du document l’habilitant à piloter des véhicules à moteur ou à traction animale. ... Il est délivré après les résultats positifs obtenus aux épreuves théoriques et pratiques subies sous supervision du Service de la Circulation. ... pour véhicule automobile dont le poids en charge n’excède pas 3,500 kg ou 3 tonnes 500. ... Le permis de conduire de type A ne sera délivré aux mineurs de 16 ans au moins qu’après autorisation expresse du Service de la Circulation. ... 2,500.00 Gdes, dont 500 Gdes au titre du FER, (Fonds d’Entretien Routier) ... La taxe est quinquennale (acquittée tous les cinq ans) ... Le permis est valable pour cinq (5) ans.
